title: My thanks to this community (Free Icons)

posts.author: Domagames
posts.body:
I can never thank this community enough, especially for their help with the "Scripts" and "Plugins". For that and because I don't like just receiving, without leaving anything in return. I wanted to leave here, an improved template of the RPG Maker MV base icons, one that I worked on for quite a while. It is so that you can use it freely, if you need it.
Thanks Again!

posts.author: ValentinaSama67
posts.body: This is awesome work! Thank you for sharing these!
